source_message.text:
Thank you. Seeing this comparison is extremely useful.

My preference is Option 1 for the baseline. I favor having the second V remain a genuinely proportional reduction of the Hero V.

There is one more adjustment I want to investigate. Please leave the second V at its current size and reduce the scale of the Es and Ls slightly so their proportions relate more naturally to it. The apparent scale of the second V’s left arm seems like an appropriate reference point.

I believe this could reinforce the hierarchy among the Hero V, the alphabet, and the second V.

É accent literal derivation and alignment
